description: City of Port Phillip Metered Lights is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Port Phillip. Known locations of current metered lights managed by the City of Port Phillip. This dataset has the location, address, address qualifier of where the metered light is located (example within a Park or, Car Park) and unique asset identification. Please note that standard street lighting is not included. Coverage: City of Port Phillip. The portal files it under the publisher City of Port Phillip. Its tags are Utilities and Communication, asset, metered lights. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEOJSON. The portal shows 2023-08-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-2.5-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
